Hose Clamp

Hose Clamp

A clamp made by winding spring-steel wire into a circular shape. It is opened with pliers, fitted over the hose, and then released so its own elasticity closes it, securing the hose onto a nipple or pipe. It is classified into A Type and B Type by end shape, and into three series — A, B, and C — by size.
